summary: Aunque miles de dominicanos confían en la Liquidación Bruta en Tiempo Real (LBTR) del Banco Central para transferir dinero de manera rápida entre entidades bancarias distintas, estas operaciones aún siguen siendo limitadas para ser tan “al instante” como lo proclama el nombre de este sistema de pago en la República Dominicana. summary: Desde el siglo XIX , los coches tirados por caballos han recorrido las calles de Manhattan y se han convertido en uno de los símbolos turísticos de la ciudad de Nueva York . title: Gutierrez: US Has Gone Too Far With Tariffs
summary: Carlos Gutierrez, former Commerce Secretary and CEO of Kellogg and author of Sheer Will, says trade under the Trump administration has become all-encompassing and can be used as part of geopolitical and political negotiations beyond trade itself. Gutierrez says the US has gone too far with tariffs and that easing them could help reduce inflationary pressure on American consumers. Gutierrez says the US has the infrastructure and capabilities to be a strong exporter, but should focus on high-value industries rather than making consumers pay more to bring back lower-value production. He speaks with Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
